from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
base = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa')
fixture_dir = base / 'fulfillment'
output = base / 'fixed-price-trial/director-byte-isolated-control.json'
original = (fixture_dir / 'synthetic-ours.csv').read_bytes()
lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
sku = 'SYN-B-BL-XXL'
old_values = [b'0000000000020', b'https://example.com/img/SYN-B-Blue-1.jpg']
new_values = [b'0000000000000', b'https://example.invalid/fictional-variant.png']
matching = [index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if sku.encode() in line]
assert len(matching) == 1, matching
record = matching[0]
for old, new in zip(old_values, new_values):
    assert lines[record].count(old) == 1
    lines[record] = lines[record].replace(old, new, 1)
modified = b''.join(lines)
def parse(raw):
    return list(csv.DictReader(raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()))
clean_rows = parse(original)
modified_rows = parse(modified)
assert len(clean_rows) == len(modified_rows) == 20
changes = []
for number, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(clean_rows, modified_rows), 1):
    for field in before:
        if before[field] != after[field]:
            changes.append(dict(record=number, sku=before['SKU'], field=field, expected=before[field], observed=after[field]))
assert {change['field'] for change in changes} == {'Barcodes', 'Variant image URL'} and all(change['sku'] == sku for change in changes) and len(changes) == 2
runs = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    work = Path(temp)
    for name in ('verify_example.py', 'verify.py', 'transform.py'):
        shutil.copyfile(base / 'runtime' / name, work / name)
    for name in ('synthetic-v.csv', 'synthetic-i.csv'):
        shutil.copyfile(fixture_dir / name, work / name)
    for name, raw in (('clean.csv', original), ('modified.csv', modified)):
        (work / name).write_bytes(raw)
        command = [sys.executable, 'verify_example.py', 'synthetic-v.csv', 'synthetic-i.csv', name]
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        try:
            checks = json.loads(result.stdout)['checks']
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            checks = None
        runs.append(dict(command=command, exit=result.returncode, sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), lf_count=raw.count(b'\n'), cr_count=raw.count(b'\r'), failed_checks=None if checks is None else [key for key, passed in checks.items() if passed is False], stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr))
expected = {'identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price', 'variant_image_is_first_image_of_its_color'}
isolated = runs[0]['exit'] == 0 and runs[0]['failed_checks'] == [] and runs[1]['exit'] == 1 and set(runs[1]['failed_checks'] or []) == expected
report = dict(synthetic=True, earlier_result='TASK-179585676100', purpose='Check whether the two cell changes alone reproduce the earlier formatting failure.', changes=changes, runs=runs, isolated_two_failures=isolated)
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
